pages.title: A Town Gives Back
pages.text: Receive your town's first positive happiness-income payment into its treasury.

pages.title: A Town Gives Back
pages.text: Shelves and provisions support the functioning town without extra currency issuance.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Income follows actual happiness of living registered residents over time. Funds enter the town treasury, not your pocket; inspect treasury and native withdrawal. Empty land and replayed requests create no income.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Coin-mode happiness income enters treasury; the old selectable tax-rate UI is retired. Standalone emerald mode has a separate contract.
